FNAF: Acronym of Five Nights at Freddy's, a video game series.
FND: Initialism of functional neurologic (or neurological) disorder.
FNMA: Initialism of Federal National Mortgage Association.
FNS: Initialism of French Naval Ship, a ship prefix for ships of the navy of the Third Republic of France.
FNUMBER: The ratio of the focal length of a lens to its diameter; a measure of the light-gathering ability of the lens.
